title: Nvidia in talks to guarantee debt for Nscale’s Anthropic data centre
content:
Nvidia is in talks to guarantee billions of dollars of debt for Nscale, the UK AI cloud company. The money would build a West Virginia data centre that Anthropic plans to use. Phoebe Liu first reported the talks for The Information on Thursday 29 October. The deal is not signed, and its terms could still change.
The guarantee would cover the value of the 460MW building itself, The Information reported. Under this kind of deal, called a residual value guarantee, Nvidia would step in if Nscale failed to make its construction payments. It would take over the site for a time and help find a buyer and a new tenant.
That is a different kind of backstop from the ones Nvidia has given other AI cloud companies, The Information reported. One investor told the outlet that Anthropic’s role likely explains Nvidia’s interest in keeping the project on track.
Brody Ford confirmed the talks for Bloomberg, citing a person familiar with the matter. The support would help cover the campus’s electricity and construction costs, he reported. Nscale declined to comment to Bloomberg, and Nvidia did not respond. Nvidia is already an investor in Nscale.
Anthropic can walk away
Anthropic signed a $45bn compute deal in August to rent computing power from the first building on the campus. The deal is more than 40% of Nscale’s $103bn revenue backlog, the Financial Times reported on Friday. The two companies are also in talks about a second $45bn deal for another building.
Nscale said in its IPO filings that it has not yet secured the money to build or equip the first building, the FT reported. Anthropic can walk away if that financing is not in place by a set deadline.
Stricter terms and a later IPO
Nvidia and the other possible backers began demanding stricter terms after markets turned, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing people familiar with the matter. That has delayed Nscale’s revised IPO prospectus.
Nscale is now leaning towards a December listing rather than November, the WSJ reported. Some of its bankers have warned that an IPO is unlikely to reach the $30bn to $35bn valuation it had targeted. That follows earlier investor pushback.
AI cloud companies such as CoreWeave, Nebius and Nscale have effectively been shut out of the bond market in recent weeks, the WSJ reported. Elon Musk said last week that debt markets had shut out these companies.
Setbacks in West Virginia
Nscale calls the site the Monarch Compute Campus. Records reviewed by the FT show it has been hit by building problems, local opposition and regulatory scrutiny. In September, state regulators ordered construction to stop for three days after runoff from the site flooded neighbouring homes. Nscale has had 10 notices of violation for poor stormwater controls.
A person close to Nscale told the FT that extreme weather caused the September flooding. The company followed every order and has fixed the damage, the person said. The first 2GW phase of the campus will run on 864 gas-fired engines.
Nscale made a net loss of $1bn on revenue of $141mn in the first half of 2026, the FT reported. Microsoft pulled out of its planned UK site this month. Chief executive Josh Payne told staff in a memo last week that demand for Nscale’s services remained “insatiable”.
Asked this month about Nscale’s problems getting its data centres online, Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang told the company to “work around the clock”.
“Try less sleep, which is what I do,” Huang added, the FT reported.

report.summary: 英伟达洽谈为Nscale数据中心债务提供担保
report.background: AI 算力扩张正从“买芯片”转向“担保融资”。Nscale 是英国的 AI 云公司，英伟达已是其股东。它在西弗吉尼亚建设 460MW 的 Monarch 园区，Anthropic 在 8 月签下 450 亿美元算力租约，约占 Nscale 1030 亿美元收入储备的 40% 以上，双方还在谈第二个 450 亿美元大单。但 Nscale 招股书承认，首栋楼的建设与设备资金尚未落实；若到期未融到资，Anthropic 可退出。与此同时，债券市场对 CoreWeave、Nebius、Nscale 这类 AI 云公司收紧，英伟达于是考虑以“残值担保”方式帮助项目融资。
key_points: 英伟达拟为 Nscale 提供“残值担保”：若 Nscale 付不起建设款，英伟达将暂时接管西弗吉尼亚 460MW 园区，并寻找买家和接盘租户。
这一担保机制与其此前对其他 AI 云公司的支持方式不同，投资者认为 Anthropic 作为核心租户，是英伟达愿意为该项目担保的关键原因，因为算力需求绑定英伟达芯片。
Anthropic 的 450 亿美元租约占 Nscale 收入储备四成以上，但它设有退出条款：若 Nscale 未在截止日前落实融资，Anthropic 可撤单。
受市场转冷影响，出资方要求更严格条款，Nscale 的招股书因此推迟，上市时间可能从 11 月挪到 12 月，300 亿至 350 亿美元目标估值或被下调。
项目本身争议不断：9 月暴雨径流淹没邻居房屋，州监管机构勒令停工三天，累计收到 10 次违规通知；公司上半年收入 1.41 亿美元、净亏损 10 亿美元。
黄仁勋对该项目的态度是“全天候赶工”“少睡点”，这反映出英伟达在算力供给上承压，也带出问题：AI 基建是否过度依赖芯片厂商为项目担保。
report.impact: 对 AI 行业而言，芯片厂商从供应商变身为项目担保方，意味着算力扩张的金融风险正向英伟达资产负债表集中，一旦租户或云厂商违约，可能引发连锁反应。对开发者来说，短期算力供给受资本运作而非技术节奏驱动，Claude 等模型的训练与推理扩容可能因融资延迟而放缓，API 价格与配额波动风险上升。对普通用户，AI 服务上线速度与稳定性将更依赖这类幕后融资能否顺利完成。
report.tools: 若想跟进这一话题，可把 CoreWeave、Nebius 的财报与债务披露作为对标样本；在 SEC EDGAR 与英国 Companies House 跟踪 Nscale 招股书更新；用 Anthropic 官方博客与 Claude API 观察算力合作动向；工程侧可关注 vLLM、SkyPilot 等多云、自建调度工具，降低对单一算力供应商的依赖。
